question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

The practice of having two or more spouses at the same time was quite common in the olden days.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Polygamy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Polygamy"** refers to the practice or custom of having more than one spouse at the same time. (बहुविवाह)

 
 
• **Example:** Polygamy was prevalent in many ancient cultures, where men often had multiple wives.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Polygamy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Patricide** (पितृहत्याकांड): The act of killing one's own father.

 
 
• **Example:** The young prince was accused of patricide after the king's mysterious death.
 
 
 
• **Patriarchy** (पितृसत्ता): A social system where men hold primary power.
 
 
• **Example:** Feminists often challenge the deep-rooted patriarchy in modern societies.
 
 
 
• **Parochialism** (संकीर्णता): A narrow-minded focus on one's own concerns or region.
 
 
• **Example:** Parochialism in politics often leads to neglect of national interests.
